title: Design System: Sales School Landing Page

display.purpose: Hero and wall headlines with compressed authority.

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Uppercase rail navigation with sparse red hover signal.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { color: #f5f8fc; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.2em; font-family: Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 300; text-decoration: none; transition: color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), opacity 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); opacity: 0.9; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #ef4444; opacity: 1; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #ef4444; outline-offset: 4px; color: #ef4444; opacity: 1; }

components.name: Hero CTA
components.description: Ghost CTA for dark hero context with touch-safe sizing.
components.css: .ds-hero-cta { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid #ffffff73; background: #ffffff1a; color: #f5f8fc; font-family: Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), border-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-hero-cta:hover { color: #fca5a5; border-color: #ef4444; } .ds-hero-cta:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #ef4444; outline-offset: 4px; border-color: #ef4444; } .ds-hero-cta:active { color: #fca5a5; }

components.name: About Rail Dot
components.description: Progress marker for narrative rail with active emphasis.
components.css: .ds-rail-dot { display: inline-block; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.34); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.34); margin-right: 8px; transition: background-color 260ms ease-out, border-color 260ms ease-out, transform 260ms ease-out, box-shadow 260ms ease-out; } .ds-rail-dot-active { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.72); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255,255,255,0.3); transform: scale(1.04); }

components.name: Work Experience Item
components.description: Two-column role row optimized for readability and overflow resilience.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-work-item { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 112px minmax(0,1fr); gap: 16px; color: oklch(0.12 0.01 255); background: transparent; } .ds-work-years { margin: 0; padding-top: 2px; font-family: Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(0.98rem,1.1vw,1.2rem); font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: oklch(0.42 0.01 255); overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-work-title { margin: 0; font-family: Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(1.34rem,1.62vw,1.92rem); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: oklch(0.14 0.01 255); overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-work-company { margin: 4px 0 0; font-family: Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(1.1rem,1.38vw,1.5rem); font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.16; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: oklch(0.31 0.01 255); overflow-wrap: anywhere; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-work-item { grid-template-columns: 128px minmax(0,1fr); gap: 20px; } }

components.name: Transition Band
components.description: Dark-to-light chapter bridge with centerline and widening panel.
components.css: .ds-transition { position: relative; min-height: 384px; max-height: 614px; height: clamp(24rem,65dvh,38.4rem); overflow: hidden; background: oklch(0.1 0.012 253); } .ds-transition-line { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 0; width: 1px; height: 100%; transform: translateX(-50%); background: oklch(0.94 0.01 255); opacity: 0.84; } .ds-transition-panel { position: absolute; inset-block: 0; left: 50%; width: 150vw; transform: translateX(-50%); background: oklch(0.93 0.005 255); }

narrative.northStar: The Decision Room to Debrief Archive
narrative.overview:
This system moves through a controlled narrative arc, a command-like dark hero where identity is asserted, then a measured transition into a light work-history surface where evidence is read. Motion is structural, not decorative, and now favors compositor-safe transforms for smoother scroll behavior.

The experience is built for recruiter-speed scanning and leadership signaling, not feature marketing. Visual density is concentrated where decisions matter, then relaxed for factual sections. This system explicitly rejects PRODUCT.md anti-references: generic SaaS styling, conversion-heavy template blocks, and product-feature storytelling.
keyCharacteristics: Two-phase palette, night-to-day progression tied to narrative flow
Display-led hierarchy with compressed hero lines and breathable body passages
Uppercase metadata language for tactical clarity
Motion as staged sequencing with reduced paint-heavy effects

rules.name: The Signal Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Red stays sparse and directional. If red becomes a dominant background treatment, the narrative hierarchy collapses.

rules.name: The Compression Rule
rules.body: Hero display lines remain tightly set so statements feel like one decisive block, not stacked banners.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Most surfaces stay flat at rest. Elevation appears only to indicate progression or anchor key imagery.

dos: Do preserve the dark-to-light narrative progression when adding new sections.
Do keep red usage sparse and intentional, mostly for directional or state cues.
Do maintain recruiter-speed hierarchy with very large display lines and concise metadata.
Do honor reduced-motion behavior and compositor-friendly motion properties.
donts: Don't design this like a generic SaaS product or app landing page.
Don't use feature-marketing patterns that feel corporate-template heavy.
Don't replace personal storytelling with conversion-led product blocks.
Don't add decorative gradient text, side-stripe accents, or nested card stacks.
